# Glossary

Plain-language definitions of the terms used in this handbook.

## A to E

### Access point

The small box on the ceiling that sends out the Wi-Fi signal. See [[Troubleshooting#Wi-Fi won't connect|Wi-Fi troubleshooting]].

### Catalogue

The list of everything the library owns, across all three buildings. See [[Architecture]].

### E-book licence

Permission from the provider to lend one copy of an e-book to one patron at a time.

## H to P

### Hold

A reservation for an item that's on loan to someone else. Patrons get a message when it's ready to collect.

### Loan limit

The most items a patron can borrow at once: 10 e-books and 5 audiobooks.

### Passphrase

A password made of several random words. It's easier to remember and harder to guess. See [[Security]].

## R to Z

### Remote image

A picture stored on another website rather than with the document. The reading software asks before showing one. See [Security](../Guides/Security.md#remote-images).

### Session

The time a patron spends signed in to a public computer. It ends after two hours or 10 minutes without activity.
